subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a multi-turn session model lease for `/model --turns N`, and should it share the same contract as the one-turn model override work tracked in #83565?
rationale: The request changes command UX, Gateway/session API shape, persisted state, turn accounting, notifications, provider/auth validation, and config defaults; those are maintainer product/API choices, not a deterministic bug fix.

options.title: Specify a unified model lease contract
options.body: Define one temporary model override contract that supports one-turn and N-turn leases with consistent auth, visibility, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before implementation.

options.title: Limit scope to one-turn overrides
options.body: Keep #83565 as the canonical API work and explicitly leave N-turn `/model --turns` leases out of scope unless future demand justifies them.

options.title: Preserve sticky model selection only
options.body: Reject temporary model leases and direct users to persistent `/model` plus manual `/model default` or existing session patch behavior.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified model lease contract
recommendation.body: Define one temporary model override contract that supports one-turn and N-turn leases with consistent auth, visibility, revert, warning, docs, and upgrade semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest feature-history signal across model override, session patch, auth profile, and live-switch behavior that would own the contract direction.
